1441985.sourceDescription:
## Features
- IP65 waterproof LED string lights
- Connectable upto 100m length
- Warm and cool white long-life LEDs

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a white rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long-lasting and energy-efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White or Warm White to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features
- Heavy-duty white rubber cable, waterproof
- Connectable up to 50m for custom displays
- Energy-saving leds with warm white glow

## Information
Create a magical atmosphere with these Cool White LED Icicle Lights, designed with a striking 60/40/20cm drop pattern and finished on durable white rubber cable. Part of our mains voltage light system, these icicle lights are built for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile option for year-round decoration. With the ability to connect multiple sets together, you can easily tailor the length to suit anything from a small porch or pergola to a full house frontage. Manufactured with heavy-duty rubber cable and waterproof ends, these icicle lights are weather-resistant and suitable for all seasons. The long-life LED bulbs provide a bright yet cool glow that enhances the charm of your outdoor or indoor setting, while also being energy efficient and reliable. Available in 2m and 5m sections, these connectable lights allow you to achieve up to 50m of continuous display with ease. Perfect for adding elegance to gutters, eaves, patios, garden structures or festive displays, they are equally at home enhancing summer evenings as they are creating a festive winter scene. Whether you choose to install them permanently or bring them out for special occasions, these Cool White Icicle Lights are designed to deliver long-lasting performance and an inviting glow that transforms any space.

So, the lights will always remember the last setting selected when turned back on. No need to worry about turning the lights on and off each night. Simply turn them on at your desired time when first using them. After that, they'll automatically light up at the same time every night. Plus, they'll automatically turn off after six hours.
